seoTitle: Sitemap Size and Limit Checker (50,000 URLs, 50 MB)
metaDescription: Check a sitemap against the 50,000 URL and 50 MB limits, see the percentage used and how many files you need. Free and private.
intro: Counts URLs and bytes in a pasted sitemap and compares them with the protocol limits.
why:
Search engines stop reading a sitemap that is too big. It is easy to cross a limit without noticing, especially with many long URLs.

This page shows how close you are to each limit and how many files a split would need. Size is measured on the pasted text, so line endings in the real file can change the number slightly.
howTo: Paste the sitemap XML or a URL list.
Read the URL count and size against each limit.
Check the number of files needed.
If it is over, use the splitter tool.
